notes.title: Motte Island Update
notes.content:
Important update:
1. bundled the air runtime for windows only.
2. added clear save button on top left on the main menu
3. force the game to always run at fullscreen at start to prevent windowed bug, you can change into windowed mode after the game launched

gameplay:
1. now you can heal by clicking on the toilet seat,
